notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q623183_aquarius_reef_base.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. On the sand beside Conch Reef off Key Largo, at about 18-19 m: the white habitat cylinder on its steel baseplate some 4 m above the bottom, the wet porch with its moon pool, the portholes of the living quarters, the equipment on top, the start of the umbilical, the small air-filled «gazebo» nearby, and the spurs of reef rock beside it. The heading and the layout round it are approximate; the life-support buoy at the surface is not drawn. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself. Rebuilt 2026-11: the baseplate girders on four braced jack legs and concrete pads, the saddles under the hull, the hull's stiffening rings and dished heads, round portholes and the big viewport in the far head, the wet porch with its moon pool and the ladder down, the divers' grating, handrails on standoffs, racks of gas bottles, floodlights on a short mast, the umbilical rising towards the buoy, and the gazebo's viewport, ballast feet and air hose.
